# Communications Reference
This section covers ground force radio systems.
Good comms keep people alive. Report contacts, keep messages short, and stay on the net.
## Guides
- [textlink="AN/PRC-117G Radio" link="AU14CommsANPRC"] The RTO manpack radio. Covers setup, slots, operating modes, COMSEC fill, retrans stations, enemy intercepts and the net log.
- [textlink="Field Headsets" link="AU14CommsHeadsets"] The standard headset. Covers named nets, encryption keys, relay range, jamming and direct frequency tuning.
- [textlink="Comms Quick Reference" link="AU14CommsQuickRef"] One-page cheat sheet for chat prefixes, ranges, antennas, radio modes, transmit power, squelch and COMSEC actions.
